senses.gloss:
रोमहर्षण

ROMAHARṢAṆA . A famous disciple of vyāsa. The great vyāsa gave the collection of Purāṇas to romaharṣaṇa. sumati, Agnivarcas, Mitrāyus, Śāṁśapāyana, akṛtavraṇa and sāvarṇi were the six disciples of romaharṣaṇa. (See under guruparamparā).

रोमक

ROMAKA . A country in ancient india. The inhabitants of this country were called the Romakas. Mention is made in mahābhārata, Sabhā Parva, Chapter 51, Stanza 17, that the Romakas came with presents to the horse-sacrifice performed by yudhiṣṭhira.

रोमशा

ROMAŚĀ . A daughter of bṛhaspati. The reply given by romaśā to her husband when he teased her, is given in ṛgveda, Maṇḍala 1, Anuvāka 19, Sūkta 126.
